The structure of Ti2Co4P4O16 (reduced formula TiCo2(PO4)2) adopts the monoclinic space group P2_1/c (No. 14), with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Co environments coordinated by six O neighbors, and octahedral P centers coordinated by three O and three Ti neighbors; Ti is four-coordinate with O. Corner-sharing is observed between Co octahedra and between P octahedra, while Co–P octahedra show both corner- and edge-sharing. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
